app.name.explanation: The product name, shown in the window title, the header and the about page. A brand name: never translate it.

common.back.explanation: Button that returns to the previous screen or step.

common.cancel.explanation: Button that closes a dialog or form without saving anything.

common.clear.explanation: Button that empties a field, search or selection.

common.close.explanation: Button that closes a panel or dialog.

common.discard_confirm.explanation: Confirmation question shown when the user leaves a form that has unsaved changes.

common.done.explanation: Button that finishes a step or closes an editing mode after the work is saved.

common.edit.explanation: Button or link that opens a record for editing.

common.error.invalid_upload.explanation: Error shown when an uploaded file can't be read or is the wrong type.

common.error.manager_or_admin_required.explanation: Error shown when a cashier tries an action only a manager or an admin may do.

common.error.network.explanation: Error shown when a request fails because the till can't reach the server or another till.

common.error.server.explanation: Generic error shown when an action fails for an unexpected reason.

common.loading.explanation: Short status text shown while a list or panel is loading.

common.money.invalid.explanation: Validation message under an amount field when the input is not a valid amount. Keep both example amounts and both separators (dot and comma).

common.money.invalid_whole.explanation: Validation message under an amount field that accepts whole numbers only.

common.no_results.explanation: Empty-state text when a search finds nothing.

common.percent.invalid.explanation: Validation message under a percentage field. Keep both examples and both separators (dot and comma).

common.show_less.explanation: Toggle that collapses an expanded list or text.

common.show_more.explanation: Toggle that expands a shortened list or text.

common.view.explanation: Button or link that opens a record read-only.
